motivation: Separate actual source-role exclusion from dictionary metadata and entity/idiom protections; raw confidence does not certify correctness.

A.candidate_pool: Same frozen complete dictionary-backed pool for every arm

C.additional_entity_idiom_guards: Only independently declared, versioned deterministic guards with exact recognized scopes and explicit allowed/ambiguous outcomes; no generic PROPN or fuzzy name suppression

shared_invariants: Identical original messages/conversation partition, dictionary candidates, target availability, source/target languages, density25%, known-word profiles, order, overlap policy, atomic-scope policy and budgets.
Only original current-message source text enters annotator. Any conversation-context variant requires separate declared arm.
Compute source token/role evidence before budget allocation; filtering cannot invent or rewrite target candidates.
Preserve recognition masks even when a known-word or budget decision displays nothing.
Preserve competing same-POS senses; POS matching is necessary evidence only, never lexical-sense approval.
No threshold tuned on116diagnostics or broad replay labels; raw POS scores retained as diagnostics.
No identifier/entity protection from predicted POS alone; existing baseline identifier controls remain identical across A/B/C.

POS_decision_policy.matching: Exact original UTF16 token or declared multi-token phrase span; preserve raw UD/composite tags and independent dictionary source POS.
POS_decision_policy.eligible: Explicit source-role compatibility; do not compare only target POS.
POS_decision_policy.incompatible: Record source_role_conflict and exclude that candidate before budget.
POS_decision_policy.unknown_or_ambiguous: Record abstention, not default sense approval; no legacy fallback inside a masked unresolved scope.
POS_decision_policy.composite_tags: Preserve e.g.PROPN+PART; do not silently collapse or shift offsets. Require separately specified mapping or abstain.
POS_decision_policy.PROPN: Coarse noun compatibility does not authorize name translation or create a blanket name veto.
POS_decision_policy.beyond_POS: No implied dependency relation, infinitive form, target morphology, idiom identity or sense resolution.

C_guard_manifest_required: source trigger and exact original UTF16 scope
permitted output identity or explicit no-output
failure/unknown policy; no changed lexical candidate inventory
reporting: Per-arm raw candidate/content-anchor availability before budget and actual displayed coverage after budget.
All displayed replacement correctness in independent heldout conversation sample, not nominated focus only.
Source-role-conflict errors, false rejection, entity/title/identifier corruption, idiom fragmentation, same-POS sense errors and abstentions separately.
Native unchanged-span geometry, selected content depth, whole-message errors and guard-trigger provenance.
Agreement/disagreement sets between A/B/C; no conditioning review only on retained correct candidates.
Conversation-level uncertainty intervals; diagnostic116reported separately from independent heldout sample.
execution_binding_still_required: Exact baseline catalog and replay-input hashes
Immutable POS compatibility mapping and C guard manifest
Independent heldout conversation IDs and evaluation rubric frozen before outputs
Explicit compute/storage/time budget and authorized execution route
Android native R8/model loading/device/API-floor qualification before any app integration
